assessments.missing_material_requirement_or_null: A workflow that extracts a presentation's narrative and tables into a clean repository text document.
assessments.rationale: It maps existing pull-request review threads to code actions; it does not convert slide content.

assessments.missing_material_requirement_or_null: A converter that extracts an existing slide deck's text and tables into a repository-friendly document.

assessments.source_anchor: ## When not to use this skill

assessments.missing_material_requirement_or_null: A presentation-to-text conversion workflow that preserves narrative, tables, and heading structure.
assessments.rationale: It generates synthetic brain-MRI volumes, which is unrelated to converting a slide deck into documentation.
It accepts PowerPoint, emits Markdown with slides as sections, handles tables, and supports version-controlled text output.

assessments.missing_material_requirement_or_null: A workflow for converting presentation content and tables into a clean text document.
assessments.rationale: It explains diminishing-musharaka finance and accounting rather than converting presentation files.

assessments.missing_material_requirement_or_null: A PowerPoint-to-text or Markdown conversion workflow for repository documentation.
assessments.rationale: It converts PDF files to editable Word documents and does not handle a slide deck or repository text output.

assessments.missing_material_requirement_or_null: A workflow that extracts an existing slide deck's narrative and tables into a clean text document.
assessments.rationale: It designs the narrative of new decks rather than converting an existing deck into searchable documentation.

assessments.missing_material_requirement_or_null: A workflow that converts slide narrative and tables into a structured text document.
assessments.rationale: It audits visual quality and layout of an existing deck rather than extracting its content.
